$Comment: The Voidtaken Breastplate, one of the three pieces of the Voidtaken Horseman's armour each of his boss waves in the restless graveyard has a small chance to bank (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Boss_Wave.json): the Horseman's own ancient steel, gone cold in the void. The game's ancient steel breastplate model and texture, the Headless Horseman's breastplate's own (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Breastplate), with no recipe (it is never crafted), the same stats a step below the iron breastplate's, and one thing more: DamageBonus_Void, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Void damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so any void weapon hits 3% harder with it on. Light is the void's violet glow it gives off, where the Horseman's gives off his ember. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Defense 20 to wear it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
